title: Decisions Behind an Admitted Action
summary: Work through Decisions Behind an Admitted Action.

sections: Decisions that leave no trace in a log

blocks.md: This lesson follows **Decisions Behind an Admitted Action** in *Responsible Physical AI* (Vol IV).

blocks.source: Vol IV, Responsible Physical AI, § Decisions Behind an Admitted Action
blocks.md: Consider one command the enforcer admitted in the aisle: a base velocity of … toward a rack end. The enforcement record shows that it passed the stopping check at that tick, under the thresholds in force, yet behind that single log line stand at least six decisions made by different people at different times. Four of them leave traces in the engineering records built in earlier chapters. The learning team trained and approved the policy weights that proposed the command.

blocks.prompt: Think first: In two or three sentences, explain why Approval record matters for the system this section describes.
blocks.md: Compare your answer with the book's claim: The approval record names, for each decision behind an admitted action, the person who approved it and answers for it, together with the human roles, permit stage, exposed groups, records about people, and shifted labor, and the release gate reads it as a standing condition so that a decision with no named owner refuses operation the way an unknown premise does.

questions.q: The section **Decisions Behind an Admitted Action** develops one of the chapter's claims. Which one?
options: An operating permit carries a duty to report incidents completely and on time, so a permit can be withdrawn for a withheld or incomplete record as well as for the motion it describes.

A human role counts as a countermeasure only if its holder has the time, information, and authority to act within the time the hazard leaves, including the queue one person serves, and a role that fails any of the three moves blame onto that person without adding protection.

Records that reconstruct an admitted action also record operators, bystanders, demonstrators, and coworkers, so each identifying record declares its purpose, retention period, what is removed before storage, and its readers, and an access and retention audit enforces the declaration as a standing condition.

The approval record names, for each decision behind an admitted action, the person who approved it and answers for it, together with the human roles, permit stage, exposed groups, records about people, and shifted labor, and the release gate reads it as a standing condition so that a decision with no named owner refuses operation the way an unknown premise does.
